definitions.explanation: A bowl of rice topped with assorted tempura, typically shrimp and vegetables, drizzled with a sweet soy-based sauce. A staple of Japanese fast-casual dining.

examples.japanese: {天丼|てんどん}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a tempura rice bowl.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}の{天丼|てんどん}は{海老|えび}が{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The shrimp in this restaurant's tempura bowl are big.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}ごはんに{天丼|てんどん}と{味噌汁|みそしる}のセットを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: For lunch, I had a tempura bowl and miso soup set.

notes:
Short for {天|てん}ぷら{丼|どんぶり}. One of the most popular {丼|どんぶり}もの (rice bowl dishes) in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天丼|てんどん}を{食|た}べる — to eat a tempura bowl
- {天丼|てんどん}セット — tempura bowl set (with soup and pickles)
- {上|じょう}{天丼|てんどん} — premium tempura bowl (with higher-quality ingredients)

RELATED WORDS:
- {天|てん}ぷら — tempura (the fried dish itself)
- {親子丼|おやこどん} — chicken-and-egg rice bowl
- {牛丼|ぎゅうどん} — beef rice bowl
- {海鮮丼|かいせんどん} — seafood rice bowl
